prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1294; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute lower back pain, muscle spasm, and limited range of motion. Initial examination showed tenderness over the paraspinal musculature of the lumbar region, reduced forward flexion, and no neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag symptoms, and the working diagnosis was lumbar strain.

Treatment over the course of care included 17 visits consisting of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Pain was managed with short-term over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication and ice or heat application as tolerated. Progress was gradual, with reduced muscle guarding and improved lumbar mobility noted at successive visits.

At discharge, the patient reported marked improvement in pain and function, returning to usual daily activities with only occasional mild discomfort on prolonged sitting. Residual limitation in end-range extension was minimal. The patient was instructed to continue a home exercise program and to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
